note: The Evening Edition's stories, rewritten for bedtime by the local model.

stories.title: Democrat Colom flips Mississippi Senate seat
stories.headline: Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate election
stories.happened: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in a close race. Officials counted absentee and provisional ballots over several days. This victory gives Mississippi its first Black senator since Reconstruction.
stories.tonight: Colom has secured the seat by a few thousand votes. Hyde-Smith conceded the race via social media.

stories.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a military base: Sources
stories.headline: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated to a military base
stories.happened: Scott Bessent moved from his Washington DC home to a military base. This relocation followed reports that identified his address. The move occurred due to security concerns regarding Iranian threats.
stories.tonight: Bessent remains committed to economic pressure against Iran. He is currently living on a military base.

stories.title: White House warns Democrats of "blatant criminality" over possible probes into Trump administration
stories.headline: White House warned Democrats about planned administration investigations
stories.happened: The White House issued a letter warning Democratic lawmakers regarding planned oversight probes. Counsel Will Scharf claimed these investigations might constitute criminality. Representative Robert Garcia vowed to continue the scrutiny.
stories.tonight: Democrats will take control of Congress in January. The incoming chair plans to pursue accountability despite threats.

local.title: Police arrest suspect in Portland model horse heist
local.headline: Police arrested a man for stealing model horses from a car
local.happened: Police arrested Benjamin Moore for the theft of miniature horse figurines. The suspect was seen distributing items in pouches near a bookstore. He faces several theft charges and has outstanding warrants.
local.tonight: The suspect is held at the Multnomah County Detention Center. Police are still seeking information regarding the missing collection.
